encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: μάρτυρας ἔχω γάρ, ὅτι μόνος φύσκην ποιῶ,
κάνδαυλον, ᾠά, θρῖον ἐν στενῷ. τί γὰρ

div.note: Athenaeus 12, 516 f μνημονεύει τοῦ κανδαύλου καὶ Φιλήμων ἐν Παρεισιόντι οὕτως κτλ. 2. φυσκην Α. 3. ωαθριον Α. στενω Α. γὰρ add. Mein. 4. ἐγένετο Α. τι] μοι Κ.

3. ᾽ἐν στενῷ brevi tempore᾽ Mein. conl. Menand. 401 στενὸν χρόνον. at ἐν στενῷ pro ἐν βραχεῖ positum nullo exemplo confirmatur, sed ubicumque invenitur, est in angustiis. neque vero interest celeriusne an tardius τὸ θρῖον faciat, dummodo bonum sit. scribendum ἐντέχνως, antiquioribus ignotum (quamquam ἔντεχνος apud Platonem philosophum), sed recentioribus non inusitatum. cf. Phryn. Epit. 344 et Lob. 345. conlato schol. Arist. Eq. 954 forsan aliquis praeferat ἐν ζωμῷ. commendat coquus artem tota urbe notam.

lg.l: περὶ τοὐπτάνιον οὐ γίνεθ᾽ ἡ σκευωρία·

div.note: Athenaeus 4, 170 f ἐκάλουν δὲ τραπεζοποιὸν τὸν τραπεζῶν ἐπιμελητὴν καὶ τῆς ἄλλης εὐκοσμίας. Φιλήμων Παρεισιόντι κτλ. 1. γίνεται Α. σκευωρία Pursan. ap. Villebr.] σκεπτωρία Α. 2. ὁ τραπ. Κ. ἐστ᾽ Dindf.] ἐστιν Α.
